_note: MB unless named ms. Set 20 Nov 2026 from the build after PR #294, with room for some more streets; the 19 Nov evening build (last known to run on an iPhone 13, at its limit) had about 280 MB canvases, 260 MB on the card and 320 MB heap at DRIVE. Raise a figure only with a reason in the commit.
_centre: After 2 km through the centre in hops (added 21 Nov 2026, the day the iPhone 13 could 'drive for a bit, then crash'). The first reading was 1058 MB in all (70 canvases, 525 on the card, 463 heap) against 553 at DRIVE (a second reading 1014), and 830 were still held 25 s after a jump back to Kvissentali: what a hand-built place paints and builds is kept once it has been visited. The limits only stop it from growing (about a tenth of room); the aim is to bring the figure down, and to lower the limits with it. Lowered from 1150 and 580 the same day, when pictures of places left behind began to rest (world/phonetex.js): 928 MB in all (71 canvases, 394 on the card with a peak of 405, 463 heap). What is left over DRIVE is mostly heap (+190) and model buffers (+80). The total lowered again from 1010 that afternoon, when the parked car models stopped holding their pictures as pixels (world/parked.js keepPacked, 50 MB): 867 MB in all. And from 945 when their detailed models were indexed in the worker and let their arrays go once on the card (76 MB of corners down to 20): 798 MB in all.
_raadiPhone: The phone at the Raadi rally stage (?raadi=1), added 24 Nov 2026 when Martin asked what the stage weighs on a phone before it leaves its flag: a fresh page, DRIVE, in along Narva mnt as the stage builds itself and in hops of 120 m along the whole stage. The first reading was 467 MB in all (74 canvases, 144 on the card with a peak of 192, 249 heap), lighter than at DRIVE (540). The limits leave about a fifth of room, so that new things at the stage show up here before they reach the phone's limit (the centre's 870).
_lowest: The lowest graphics level (light mode + extra low + GRAPHICS LOW) at the Riia and Turu junction, added 21 Nov 2026 after two old laptops ran at 10 to 18 FPS. The check reads 386 pieces and 634 thousand triangles there; the limits leave about a fifth of room. (Counted another way at the same junction, before and after the extra low level: 461 pieces and 957 thousand triangles, then 383 and 577.)
_stageDraw: Pieces and triangles drawn in a frame along the Raadi rally stage (?raadi=1), the heaviest of three views (the start line, a third and two thirds along), at the lowest level (as lowest above) and at a desktop's top level (GRAPHICS HIGH). Added 24 Nov 2026 when Martin asked for more Raadi in the nightly check. Two runs of the check read 121 pieces and 351 thousand triangles at the lowest level (the Riia and Turu junction reads about 350 and 550), and 533 and 549 pieces, 2439 and 2450 thousand triangles at the top level (one probe that morning read 672 and 2709: which far ground squares have loaded moves it). Nearly all of the top level's triangles are the map's ground squares (about 51 thousand each), seen far across the open park; the park's 370 stones are one piece of 30 thousand. The lowest limits leave about a fifth of room, the top ones about a fifth over the highest reading.
_drive: The test drive through the centre (4.5 km, about 98 s). Set 21 Nov 2026 at about twice the readings after the freeze-frame fix (PR #372), the smaller house-front pages and Pepleri, Delta and the Catholic school built in steps. Seven drives read: the game busy for over 0.1 s 0 times (1 before those three places were stepped), longest 65 to 85 ms, 0.3 to 0.6 s in stretches over 50 ms, 95th percentile 5 to 8 ms. The code before the fix read 12 and 19 times over 0.1 s, longest 379 and 669 ms, 3.8 and 6.4 s (desktop and phone). Gaps between frames over 0.1 s: 0 or 1 after the fix (the 1 is the software drawing process stalling, which is why the longest gap has no budget), 15 and 26 before. These replace the old desktop figure (15 frames standing at the start).
_stage: A run of the Raadi rally stage (?raadi=1, added 23 Nov 2026 when Martin asked for the stage in the nightly check): 0.57 km in along Narva mnt as the stage builds itself, the start clock, then the 1.73 km stage past the finish, about 57 s. The timing budgets are the lap's. Four drives of that day read: busy over 25 ms 2 to 3 times, over 33 ms 0 or 1, longest 28 to 48 ms, no frame over 33 ms; 24 megapixels sent to the card, never over 1.1 in a frame, at most 1.05. The picture budgets leave about two thirds of room.
_crowd: 60 players online (tools/crowd-hitch.cjs), added 24 Nov 2026 after Martin felt hitches with 55 to 78 online. Before the fix the online code kept the page busy for over 5 ms 56 times in 40 s, at most 13.3 ms (the player list made anew); after it 3 times, at most 5.4 to 10 ms (other cars' tyre marks, a join). The limits leave room for the run-to-run spread and catch the list coming back. The same limits judge 30 s of a race of 30 (added the same evening, Martin: almost 30 in a race): before its fix the ghost cars' shaders took 13 to 30 ms each (4 times over 5 ms, most 30.6), after 3 to 5 times, most 5.2 to 7.9.
_shaders: Shaders built the iPhone way (tools/crowd-hitch.cjs slowLink, menu), added 24 Nov 2026 after /stats showed most phone freezes of 1 s or more drawing new shaders. Before the fix 9 programs first used inside drawing after DRIVE, 4 in one frame; after it 2, 1 in a frame (a parked car and a remote car's scanned body coming later, run to run they vary). The limits leave room for that spread and catch a new place or car that draws its shaders in the frame again.
